name: ankle circles
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended. Lift one foot off the ground and rotate your ankle in a circular motion. Repeat in the opposite direction.

name: assisted lying calves stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg extended. Use a resistance band or a partner to pull your toes towards you, stretching your calf. Hold the position and repeat on the other leg.

name: band single leg calf raise
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under one foot. Grasp the band and raise your heel off the ground, then lower and repeat. Switch to the other leg.

name: band single leg reverse calf raise
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under one foot. Grasp the band and lift the front of your foot off the ground, then lower and repeat. Switch to the other leg.

name: band two legs calf raise - (band under both legs) v. 2
instructions: Stand with a resistance band secured under both feet. Grasp the band and raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell floor calf raise
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your shoulders. Raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell seated calf raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with a barbell across your thighs. Raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell seated calf raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with a barbell across your thighs. Raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell standing calf raise
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your shoulders. Raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell standing leg calf raise
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your shoulders. Raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: barbell standing rocking leg calf raise
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your shoulders. Rock forward onto your toes, then rock back onto your heels. Repeat.

name: bodyweight standing calf raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: box jump down with one leg stabilization
instructions: Stand on a box with one foot. Jump down and land on one foot, stabilizing yourself. Repeat on the other leg.

name: cable standing calf raise
instructions: Stand with a cable machine set to a low position. Grasp the handle and raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: cable standing one leg calf raise
instructions: Stand with a cable machine set to a low position. Grasp the handle and raise one heel off the ground, then lower and repeat. Switch to the other leg.

name: calf push stretch with hands against wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands against it. Push against the wall and step one foot back, keeping your heel on the ground. Hold the stretch and repeat on the other leg.

name: calf stretch with hands against wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands against it. Push against the wall and step one foot back, keeping your heel on the ground. Hold the stretch and repeat on the other leg.

name: calf stretch with rope
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended. Loop a rope around one foot and pull your toes towards you, stretching your calf. Hold the position and repeat on the other leg.

name: circles knee stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees slightly and make circular motions with your knees, then reverse the direction.

name: donkey calf raise
instructions: Place your hands on a bench and bend at the waist. Raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: dumbbell calf jump
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Jump and raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: dumbbell calf raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.

name: dumbbell standing calf raise
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Raise your heels off the ground, then lower and repeat.
